name: field-onboarding-assignment
objective: Close the authoritative assignment lifecycle used by Partners and app-field without making assignment mandatory for every onboarding.
truthOwner: DSH owns field onboarding assignments; Workforce supplies eligible active Field providers; Work Queue is the mobile source of assigned work.

tasks.objective: Make assigned Field work deterministic, auditable and operationally useful.
tasks.currentProblem: Assignment exists but must be proven free from raw-ID/scope shortcuts and lacks the final approved policy for one-active assignment, formal handoff, priority/dueAt/SLA and event-location readiness.
tasks.requiredChange: Use real provider picker, one active assignment per business task, immutable provenance, formal handoff after work starts, cancellation rules, priority/dueAt/SLA/overdue, optional GPS hint at assignment and mandatory governed location proof before visit/onboarding completion; expose it in Work Queue and object-scoped collaboration.
tasks.targetState: Partners assigns eligible active Field provider by identity, app-field receives the task in Work Queue, handoff/reassign/cancel preserve history, linked draft keeps assignment provenance, and no assignment grants broad store authority or publishes anything.
tasks.action: Trace existing assignment domain/UI/API/DB and Workforce scope integration; remove raw-ID business-task substitutes, add missing fields/transitions/audit/permissions/read models and concurrency/idempotency tests.
mustNotChange: Assignment ليست شرطًا لبدء self-initiated onboarding.
لا إنشاء Store public عند assignment.
لا broad Workforce scope كبديل للمهمة.
لا أكثر من assignment نشط لنفس المهمة دون formal transition.
acceptanceCriteria: priority/dueAt/SLA/overdue تظهر وتُقرأ من نفس الحقيقة.
Work Queue هو canonical assigned-work reader وPush تنبيه فقط.
wrong Field actor cannot read/mutate another assignment.
tasks.rollback: Preserve assignment/draft history and forward-fix; never restore raw Actor ID scopes as business tasks.
tasks.commitBoundary: Assignment domain and its two required surfaces only.
